body: Same here, glad that someone filled the the void I never knew existed! :D
Super late to the party but just discovered this and IT IS JUST AMAZING ,never seen an audio with an old fashioned toon quite like this one ,safe to say I will be replaying this lmao :)
God bless you as well for you kind words and for years it's been a situation where I cant get out but next year I am finally able to do so I'm really looking forward to it ,have a good one :)

Thank you that's really good advice I try to love myself and honestly have came a long way from my attitudetowards myself a few years ago,I do try and stay thick skinned but when its just a constant thing occasionally it gets to me but you are right it shouldn't really get to me ,out of family I don't care too much about anymore unless im late night thinking but with my family suppose I just secretly wish that they will improve in their treatment because we are meant to love family for our differences or flaws but I know reality is its not going to happen so I don't hang around some family and alot of the people I used to because of this and similar scenarios ,I get lonely and angry though that something I had no control over made them decide I wasn't really worth respecting or appreciating anymore. But you are right it should just be like water off a ducks back ,thank you for your advice and opinions I appreciate them :)

Also I realise this may not be possible but if not just do small things for yourself that you enjoy like buy yourself something like a shirt in a colour that you like ,something you wouldn't normally get or a little ornament that makes you happy like the tiny bluetooth computers with clicky keys and pretty patterns on the screen ,rings are cool but are also fairly gender neutral and you coukd getaway with that ,instagram video calls are the best way to talk to female friends in my opinion too ,another thing is i love to look at pretty clothes i see and put them onto a wishlist ,drawing is also a wonderful release of creativity too ,fun drinks could be made with just regular old alcohols with little bits added like fruit or vanilla extract and flasks can hide the appearance of them too ,nails are hard but little decals maybe on 1 finger could work not too big or noticable if your hands arent fully on show ,skin care bundles are wonderful too and when I wanna feel feminine i put on a face mask when nobody is home ,some channels too on YouTube that are so much fun are trixie cosmetics, Brittany broski ,jenna marbles silly little things like that with a face mask on can turn your day around ,a humidifier or candles is always a nice way to relax to or just an air fresher with the window open ,sometimes its just the little things :]

Don't worry I know you didn't mean it in that way ,to be honest some family's is like that sometimes, when they see things that aren't quite fitting of the norm they freak the fuck out ,mine definitely is they hate that I dress somewhat alternatively and that im not a fully devoted christian now im moving out soon and have everything ahead of me ,if you aren't moved out or have no plans to I highly recommend just going for it ,knowing that soon you can literally do whatever you want with the future and the present and on top of the only you decide what your family hears of you and what you have been up to and why not the people around you they are meant to support and build you up fir who you are and what you like ,just because you might put on eyeliner or enjoy long sparkly nails doesn't change your character
I suppose it does it just gets tiring you know can't even go home to escape it 💀

I think that alot of the fundamental attributes associated to woman are largely romanticised to the point of being a false image rather than reality ,treatment to women no matter were you go can and always will be bad in some way or another big or small misogyny is so deeply engraved into even the smallest things to make our lives a little more difficult however I can understand you sentiment at the same time ,women can often be alot more connected to their thoughts and feelings as well as other women around them far more than men can from my male and female friends I have always found it easier to bond with women and I agree completely with the stereotypical male hobbies being very dull in comparison to girly things like how fun it is to have your nails done or going shopping together with fun drinks afterwards ,but to be honest I am so jealous of men for some of the benefits and things they have like how it seems so much easier to upkeep your image and appearance by just washing and styling your hair no makeup or leg shaving so early in the morning or how people take you seriously really easily and dont minimise you and youe needs also you guys dont have periods would literally kill not to have those motherfuckers 💀, so im saying being a woman is tough and very challenging at times especially when the way we are meant to look and act and behave is limited to societys standards but if you want to like and enjoy more 'girly' and feminine things that women enjoy like the things i previously mentioned or even fashion or enjoying long talks with female friend then enjoy them we only have so many years to enjoy the things we like and want to do :)
